verdict.rationale: monday.com documents several handoff mechanisms. Agents can be assigned items, @mentioned, and messaged in updates, with replies and statuses included. One agent identity is reachable across Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram, Make, MCP, and the API, external agents connect via a hosted MCP, and 2-way sync links outside tools. However, the evidence never explicitly addresses preserving context or state when work passes between agents or tools; that is only implied by work living on shared board items. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of context and state transfer during agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool handoff, and independent or hands-on corroboration that handoffs retain information.
